correctness.rationale: Exact F_2 reciprocal cyclotomic pairs at powers 7 plus the endpoint condition classify all 2^k words. Unique balanced seven-adic differences and local perfect 3-point differences give all integer correlations. The positive-shift histogram is a direct count; conditioned binomial CLT follows. Sixth Fourier moment is the zero Fourier coefficient of a Riesz product with cubed local polynomial; an exact three-state carry matrix reduces to 2x2 characteristic polynomial x^2-118x+873, proving the recurrence and asymptotic. The packaged independent arithmetic finite checker confirms depths 1..5 and moments through depth 4. No finite check is used as an infinite proof.
